build_check.description: index.html and game_logic.js exist, a canvas/WebGL renderer is present, and no disallowed heavy runtime asset references are used.

requirements.description: Spawn geometric beat targets in multiple lanes and judge key input with Perfect, Good, and Miss timing windows tied to a deterministic chart. Score 0 if the system is absent, decorative, or cannot be completed through player input. Score 1 requires the full interaction and its success/failure consequences to be observable in one playable flow.

Use Web Audio API synthesis and an analyser so emissive materials, tunnel segments, and camera impulses respond to current frequency bands. Score 0 if the system is absent, decorative, or cannot be completed through player input. Score 1 requires the full interaction and its success/failure consequences to be observable in one playable flow.

Shatter successful targets into velocity-aware physical fragments while misses pass the player and cause a distinct tunnel distortion.
